candidate_windows.window_text: For VEGAD, we use Jieba as the text segmentation tool. We train all models on the domain-specific task for 3 epochs. The train batch size is set to 8, learning rate to $5 \times 10^{-5}$ , and we use the cosine scheduler. The LLM is based on Qwen1.5 (Bai et al., 2023) with 1.8B parameters. We download the parameters from HuggingFace $^{12}$ , and finetuned the model with LoRA (Hu et al., 2021) on 1 A100 80G GPU. The rank is set to 16. Only the parameters of the embedding layer, language modeling head layer of newly added vocabulary and the adapters are trainable, while the others are frozen.
